info.title: SIGARRA
info.description:
SIGARRA, the academic information system of the University of Porto.

## Authentication

Authenticated requests need two session cookies, `SI_SESSION` and `SI_SECURITY` (both are required). `HTTP_SESSION`, which HTML pages set when a request has none, has no effect on authentication or on responses. Sessions are bound to the IP address that created them (the one that logged in, or that called `/auth/oidc/token`): from any other address, requests are treated as unauthenticated, although the session keeps working from the original address. The calendar API (`/calendarios-api/`) is the exception: it accepts a session from any address. Sessions expire and there is no refresh endpoint: authenticate again to get new cookies. `GET /{faculty}/{language}/vld_validacao.sair` ends a session. There are three ways to get them:

1. **Credentials.** `POST /{faculty}/{language}/vld_validacao.validacao` (the website's login form) with `p_user` and `p_pass` sets the cookies; `mob_val_geral.autentica` is a JSON alternative. Any faculty path works, including `up`. The cookies have no expiry date, but the session itself ends about 2 hours after logging in, regardless of activity (observed once; it matches the 2 hours of OIDC sessions).
2. **OpenID Connect.** Get a token from the U.Porto identity provider, a Keycloak realm at `https://open-id.up.pt/realms/sigarra` (discovery: `/.well-known/openid-configuration`), then exchange it for the cookies at `GET /auth/oidc/token`. Each exchange creates a new session that lasts 2 hours, regardless of the token's own lifetime. Apps need their own client registered in that realm (redirect URIs are checked); [uni](https://github.com/NIAEFEUP/uni)'s tokens have the audiences `it-sigarra-oidc-bridge` and `catalogo-apis`. Access tokens last 15 minutes; with the `offline_access` scope, the refresh token does not expire. The password grant rejects U.Porto credentials (`invalid_grant`), so tokens have to be obtained through a browser (authorization code flow, with PKCE for public clients). The `uporto_data` scope adds U.Porto claims to the token and user info: `nmec` (student number, without `up`) and `ous` (faculty acronyms, e.g. `["FEUP"]`).
3. **SAML (browser only).** `GET /{faculty}/{language}/vld_validacao.federate_login` redirects to U.Porto's Shibboleth identity provider at `wayf.up.pt`; SIGARRA is the service provider `https://sigarra.up.pt/shibboleth`.

Without a valid session, JSON endpoints answer `403` with `{"erro", "erro_msg"}`, HTML pages answer `403` with an error page, and the calendar API answers `403` with an empty body. Some pages answer `200` with an error page instead; this is noted on each of them.

## Other conventions

- Pages under `/{faculty}/{language}/` are PL/SQL procedures: an unknown or missing parameter makes SIGARRA answer `404`.
- Many JSON endpoints are served with an inaccurate content type; they are noted individually.

post.description:
Authenticates with a username and password; this is the website's login form (served by `vld_validacao.login`). Works on any faculty path, including `up`.

On success, sets `SI_SESSION` and `SI_SECURITY` (no expiry date; the session lasts about 2 hours) and redirects with a `<meta http-equiv="refresh">` to `p_address` (`web_page.Inicial` by default). On failure, the reason is in `p.aviso-invalidado` (e.g. "O conjunto utilizador/senha não é válido." for a wrong username or password, "A sua conta encontra-se bloqueada." for a locked account, or an expired password). If the request already carries a valid session, the page is titled "Problema encontrado" ("Problem found"), `p.erro-nota` says "Já se encontra autenticado com o utilizador <name>." ("You are already authenticated as <name>."), and no new session is created.

Used by [uni](https://github.com/NIAEFEUP/uni).

p_user.description: Username, with or without the `up` prefix (e.g. `up20YYXXXXX` or `20YYXXXXX`).

p_address.description: Page to redirect to after logging in. Defaults to `web_page.Inicial`.

200.description: HTML page. See the description for how to tell success from failure.

Set-Cookie.description: On success, `SI_SESSION` (`HttpOnly`) and `SI_SECURITY` (`Secure; HttpOnly`), without an expiry date.

get.description:
Ends the session: its cookies stop working. Then redirects to `web_page.Inicial` with a `<meta http-equiv="refresh">`. Answers the same without a session.

Used by [uni](https://github.com/NIAEFEUP/uni).

200.description: HTML page that redirects to the home page.

get.description:
Exchanges a token from the U.Porto identity provider (`https://open-id.up.pt/realms/sigarra`) for SIGARRA session cookies. Both access tokens and ID tokens are accepted. The session is bound to the IP address that makes this call, so call it from wherever the session will be used (e.g. a backend, not the browser that obtained the token). Each call creates a new session that lasts 2 hours (`exp` is 7200 s after the request), regardless of the token's own lifetime. [uni](https://github.com/NIAEFEUP/uni)'s tokens have the audience `it-sigarra-oidc-bridge`, likely the name of this service.

Answers `401` without a token and `403` with an invalid one. Only `GET` is allowed (`405` otherwise).

Used by [uni](https://github.com/NIAEFEUP/uni).

exp.description: When the session cookies expire, as a Unix timestamp: 2 hours after the request.

get.description:
Institutional page generator. Only `/up/pt/web_base.gera_pagina?p_pagina=escolas` (the list of faculties) still answers: it redirects (`301`) to `https://www.up.pt/portal/pt/conhecer/sobre-a-uporto/as-faculdades/`. Any other combination (another faculty, another page, or no `p_pagina`) is refused by the web server with a generic `403`.

Used by [uporto-schedule-scrapper](https://github.com/NIAEFEUP/uporto-schedule-scrapper).

301.description: Redirect to the list of faculties on `www.up.pt`.

403.description: Refused by the web server (generic Apache page).

Vacancies in each class of a course's course units, for the current class enrolment period (e.g. "Inscrições nas turmas 1º Semestre - 2026/2027", the 1st semester's class enrolments). The data is a table with one row per course unit and pairs of columns (class, vacancies). The course doesn't need to belong to the faculty in the path.

Used by [uporto-schedule-scrapper](https://github.com/NIAEFEUP/uporto-schedule-scrapper).

get.description: A course unit occurrence's page: name, acronym ("Sigla:" / "Acronym:"), occurrence (`h2`, e.g. "Ocorrência: 2023/2024 - 1S"), and the "Ciclos de Estudo/Cursos" (study cycles/courses) table (course, curricular year, ECTS).
